### G0: comparison harness v2 and current parity baseline

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.gap-g0-comparison-truth/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1` · **at risk**

Replace the misleading PowerShell-only comparison loop with a dependency-free Python core and compatibility wrapper that builds equivalent-output curves, times frozen settings in counterbalanced order, records complete provenance and work metadata, and emits authoritative JSONL plus derived flat summaries. Establish a scoped current photo baseline before changing encoder policy.

### G1: diagnostic edge-flat risk atlas

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.gap-g1-edge-risk-atlas/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1` · **at risk**

Add an explicit diagnostic-only AnalysisAtlasV2 and JSONL export with source-side edge, smoothness, noise and covariance features. Correlate them against JPXL reconstruction leakage on held-out images without changing production analysis or encoding decisions; continue to G2 only if the top-risk area concentrates failures.
